data: For fiscal 2025, the year ended September 27, 2025, Apple reported total net sales of $416.161 billion, up about 6.4% from $391.035 billion in fiscal 2024. Products contributed $307.003 billion and Services $109.158 billion. Net income was $112.010 billion, up roughly 19.5% from $93.736 billion in fiscal 2024, and diluted earnings per share were $7.46. Part of that net income growth reflects a lower tax provision of $20.719 billion, compared with $29.749 billion the year before. Total assets at the end of fiscal 2025 were $359.241 billion, down about 1.6% from $364.980 billion at the end of fiscal 2024. These figures come from Apple's Form 10-K filed October 31, 2025.
